title: The meta cleavage of catechol by Azotobacter species. 4-Oxalocrotonate pathway.
disposition: Native parent EV-EXP-IDA cites this 1971 Azotobacter study. Europe PMC has no abstract. Publisher-indexed abstract is a lead; direct PDF returned403. Do not claim full experimental review.

title: Physically associated enzymes produce and metabolize 2-hydroxy-2,4-dienoate, a chemically unstable intermediate formed in catechol metabolism via meta cleavage in Pseudomonas putida.
disposition: Read all644 numbered lines across8 pages from verified prior publisher transformations. No raw PDF or visual figure review. Preserves separate native PaW1 and heterologous preparations, historical mass uncertainties, enzyme association, keto/enol specificity and Mg dependence. Methods reverses xylH/xylI relative to abstract/discussion and1990 mapping; confirm sequence identities before curation. The paper’s spontaneous-product interpretation must be reconciled with later compound distinctions.

title: 4-Oxalocrotonate tautomerase, its homologue YwhB, and active vinylpyruvate hydratase: synthesis and evaluation of 2-fluoro substrate analogues.
disposition: Engineered E109Q/E111Q decarboxylase/hydratase complexes and fluorinated inhibitors. Do not transfer mutant results to unmodified proteins or universal assembly requirements.

title: The meta cleavage operon of TOL degradative plasmid pWW0 comprises 13 genes.
disposition: TOL pWW0 operon mapping and E.coli maxicell expression. Historical xylQ/xylT functions explicitly unknown; neither inferred enzyme assignment nor whole-route host occurrence follows.

title: Degradation of 2,3-dihydroxybenzoate by a novel meta-cleavage pathway.
disposition: Different 2,3-dihydroxybenzoate entry in P.reinekei MT1; shared downstream activities are relevant leads. Whole catechol route is not directly demonstrated by this abstract. EPMC fullTextXML returned500.

title: A novel 2-aminomuconate deaminase in the nitrobenzene degradation pathway of Pseudomonas pseudoalcaligenes JS45.
disposition: Nitrobenzene/2-aminomuconate route, not catechol route. Successful initial web publisher reading covered methods/results/discussion and reported7-min spontaneous conversion; subsequent attempts to retain web response timed out and EPMC XML returned500. Source details are a follow-up lead until reproducibly retained. Do not transfer deaminase cofactors or assembly to tautomerase.

title: Purification and properties of the physically associated meta-cleavage pathway enzymes 4-hydroxy-2-ketovalerate aldolase and aldehyde dehydrogenase (acylating) from Pseudomonas sp. strain CF600.
disposition: Native CF600 aldolase/acylating-dehydrogenase complex supports terminal two-step scope. Full main transformation is available in prior261 primary package but not newly read completely in this discovery task.

title: Identification of functional residues in a 2-hydroxymuconic semialdehyde hydrolase. A new member of the alpha/beta hydrolase-fold family of enzymes which cleaves carbon-carbon bonds.
disposition: Hydrolytic XylF specificity and engineered variant study; adjacent alternative, not oxidative-branch membership.

title: The evolution of pathways for aromatic hydrocarbon oxidation in Pseudomonas.
disposition: Review article cited by broadGO definition; not independent primary evidence for this exact route.
